answer:
The Filipino statesman is **Manuel L. Quezon**.  
During World II he organized the Philippine Commonwealth government‑in‑exile in the United States. Prior to that, Quezon briefly served as the **Acting Mayor of Quezon City** (he held the position from 12 October 1939 to 4 November 1939, after the city was established that same year).
